objective: Continue failed integrations through token-bound correction runs without resetting claims, scope or attempts

acceptance.text: Correction preparation binds an actual failed M result or a discriminated no-M I/C conflict probe record to an immutable token and unchanged approved contract; free-form failures, stale identities, changed scope and duplicate work fail before mutation.

Correction start verifies the exact clean recorded M or no-M I checkout on its unique branch and publishes only a typed legal Execution/run pair, retaining original finished runs, actual starting story state and MAX spent budgets across generations; exhausted attempts and invalid journals cannot mutate state.

Fresh correction gates/review/distinct verification cover the full original task lineage and inherited findings before C2 integration; temporary Git regressions exercise both basis variants, unclaimed/older I, active duplicates, raised MAX, torn token/story/run recovery and rejected drift without baseline or budget reset.
